limits: Tier damage input is transformed by the builder; final damage depends on attribute construction and gameplay
Stored tier speed is not necessarily attack speed: tool tiers and explicit overrides are separate
Five Maul overload traces route nominal speed into the extra-damage argument and zero into the speed argument; runtime acceptance is still required
Pluton Scythe one-argument registration resolves an inherited helper; its separate two-argument Luck helper is not reached by this selected factory path
Normal tier noRepair does not prohibit every custom recipe or enchantment-based repair system
